'''''Concert Solo''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to promote a series of concerts by a [[Unidentified Bith musician (concert solo)/Legends|Bith musician]] on the urban [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Couruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It showed the [[Musician/Legends|musician]] performing with an instrument against a luminous background, with a caption at the bottom written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script. The poster was put up in such diverse places as [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]], in and outside [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]],<ref name="LT" /> as digital billboard advertisements on [[Hover taxi/Legends|hover taxis]],<ref name="LT" /><ref name="Catch" /> in an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]],<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> on a [[Holobooth/Legends|holobooth]] on the [[Corner of twelfth and G/Legends|corner of twelfth and G]] on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]],<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref><ref name="Wrong" /> and on a wall on the same level.<ref name="Wrong">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
